page.layout: No printed text block. Only show-through from the opposite page (mirrored title letters at the top right), a seal impression at the left, and manuscript pencil notes at the lower left.
page.notes: Blank leaf. The faint, mirrored capitals at the top (apparently "EVANGELIUM") are show-through from the other side and are not transcribed. The oval seal impression at the left, and the handwritten "U", "1721" and "Res XVII" in pencil at the lower left, are ownership or shelf marks and are not transcribed.
